FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8 AS build
WORKDIR /app
RUN corepack enable
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
RUN cd server && npm ci && npm run db:generate
RUN VITE_API_URL=/api pnpm run build
RUN node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const seed=fs.readFileSync("server/prisma/seed.ts","utf8"); const prefix=seed.slice(0,seed.indexOf("  const adminHash")); const tail="  const password = process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD; if (!password || !process.env.JWT_SECRET) throw new Error(\"Required runtime secrets are missing\"); const existing = await prisma.admin.findUnique({where:{username:\"sindiswa-cell\"}}); if (!existing) { const passwordHash=await bcrypt.hash(password,12); await prisma.admin.create({data:{username:\"sindiswa-cell\",fullName:\"System Administrator\",email:\"sindiswa-cell@localhost\",passwordHash,mustChangePassword:false,active:true}}); }\n}\nawait main(); await prisma.$disconnect();\n"; fs.writeFileSync("bootstrap.ts",prefix+tail);'
RUN printf '%s\n' 'import express from "express";' 'import http from "node:http";' 'import {spawn} from "node:child_process";' 'import fs from "node:fs";' 'if (!process.env.JWT_SECRET || !process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD) throw new Error("Missing runtime secrets");' 'fs.mkdirSync("/app/.data/uploads",{recursive:true});' 'const init=spawn(process.execPath,["--import","tsx","bootstrap.ts"],{stdio:"inherit"});' 'const code=await new Promise(resolve=>init.on("exit",resolve)); if(code!==0) process.exit(1);' 'const api=spawn(process.execPath,["--import","tsx","server/src/index.ts"],{stdio:"inherit",env:{...process.env,PORT:"4000"}});' 'api.on("exit",()=>process.exit(1));' 'for(let i=0;;i++){try{const r=await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health");if(r.ok)break;}catch{} if(i>100)process.exit(1);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}' 'const app=express();' 'app.use((req,res,next)=>{if(!req.url.startsWith("/api/")&&!req.url.startsWith("/uploads/"))return next();const upstream=http.request({hostname:"127.0.0.1",port:4000,path:req.url,method:req.method,headers:req.headers},r=>{res.writeHead(r.statusCode,r.headers);r.pipe(res);});upstream.on("error",()=>res.sendStatus(502));req.pipe(upstream);});' 'app.use(express.static("/app/dist"));' 'app.get("/{*path}",(_req,res)=>res.sendFile("/app/dist/index.html"));' 'const listener=app.listen(8080,"0.0.0.0");' 'for(const signal of ["SIGTERM","SIGINT"])process.on(signal,()=>{listener.close();api.kill(signal);process.exit(0);});' > launch.mjs
RUN mkdir -p /app/.data && rm -rf server/uploads && ln -s /app/.data/uploads server/uploads
FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8 AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production DATABASE_URL=file:/app/.data/application.sqlite HOME=/tmp TMPDIR=/tmp
COPY --from=build /app/server/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/package.json ./package.json
COPY --from=build /app/server ./server
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/bootstrap.ts ./bootstrap.ts
COPY --from=build /app/launch.mjs ./launch.mjs
RUN mkdir -p /app/.data && chown 10001:10001 /app/.data
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["node","launch.mjs"]

{
  "name": "ihoped-system",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.0.0",

    "dev": "vite",
    "dev:server": "npm --prefix server run dev",
    "dev:all": "npm --prefix server run dev",
    "build": "tsc -b && vite build",
    "test": "tsc -b --pretty false",
    "lint": "oxlint",
    "preview": "vite preview",
    "db:setup": "npm --prefix server run db:setup"
  },
  "dependencies": {

  },

    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^6.1.2",
    "oxlint": "^1.90.0",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.3.4",

  }
}
